tweet.text:
🟢 +$28,504.80 today across my accounts.

At this point, you should be getting bored of watching me trade the same thing 😂🦜

You keep seeing the same setups because I keep taking the same setups 😂🦜

That’s the whole point.

I don’t need a fancy order-flow screen or gamma dashboard to execute MY edge.

Session highs. Session lows. Breakouts. Fakeouts.

I know my range. Then I watch how price behaves at its edges.

Break out and hold? I’m looking for continuation.

Sweep a level and fail back inside? I’m looking for the reversal.

For longs, I want a pullback into discount. Not an emotional entry because a green candle started running without me.

The direction changes. The framework doesn’t.

Look through the charts I post. Day after day, you’ll see the same ideas, the same levels and the same decision process.

I’m not trying to discover a new strategy every morning.

I’m trying to execute the one I already understand.

Today I kept size smaller ahead of tomorrow’s FOMC decision. I wasn’t expecting a session to swing big, so I didn’t size like it.

Tomorrow could move fast. I might trade it. I might sit it out.

A big event on the calendar doesn’t mean I owe the market a trade.

Beautiful day at the Green Bird ports. Take the gains, call it a day, keep building.

The goal isn’t to make trading look complicated.

It’s to make my decisions repeatable.

🦜 Calm Under Pressure.
